params.message:
One parser for model JSON, one reader for reference ids

parseLLMJson lived in classify, discover, enrich and suggest as four copies that
differed only in which salvaged objects they kept. It is now core/llm-json.mjs with
that choice as a parameter; ingest-report asks for an object and keeps its own.
The tag-column reader (tagIds three times, a local ids() once) is refIds in
concept-id.mjs, and query-endpoint uses unwrapRef instead of its own conceptRefId.
